title: WrapString with lim=1 never wraps single-character words
property: in the output, any line containing more than one word is no wider than lim when every word fits within lim
expected: "a\nb" (each one-character word fits the limit on its own line)
evidence: Doc: 'WrapString wraps the given string within lim width in characters'; only words longer than lim are described as pathological. The condition `wordBufLen < lim` at line 64 is false for a one-character word when lim == 1, so the break is skipped even though the word fits on a fresh line.
